content.title: YouTube TV could lose Disney channels, Getty's new AI partnership
content.description:
Morning Brief host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including streaming giant Netflix (NFLX) announcing a 10-for-1 stock split, Alphabet's (GOOG, GOOGL) YouTube TV to lose Disney-owned (DIS) channels unless a new distribution agreement is reached, and Getty Images (GETY) striking a new partnership with Perplexity (PEAI.PVT).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.

content.summary: Shares of visual content marketplace Getty Images (NYSE:GETY) fell 7.5% in the morning session after the UK's competition regulator announced its intent to refer the company's proposed merger with Shutterstock for an in-depth Phase 2 review.
